name: game-feel

original_frontmatter.name: game-feel
original_frontmatter.description: Adds engine-neutral juice to a working mechanic: trauma-based screen shake, hit-stop, eased tweens, squash and stretch, and knockback. Use when the game feels flat, weightless or not punchy, or hits and jumps should feel satisfying. Not for coyote time (`platformer`), input buffering (`input-systems`), camera follow (`camera-systems`) or HUD layout (`game-ui-ux`).
